scripts.text: You have too many items to proceed with the quest.
scripts.translation: 你的物品太多，无法继续任务。

scripts.text: Please lighten your load and try again.
scripts.translation: 请先减轻负重，再重试。

scripts.text: We provide missions and daily quests that you can complete in the region of {0}.
scripts.translation: 我们提供可在{0}地区完成的任务和每日委托。

scripts.text: There are simple daily quests as well as missions that you have to complete within the siege hours only. So, think about it~
scripts.translation: 其中有简单的每日委托，也有只能在攻城战期间完成的任务。好好考虑一下吧~

scripts.text: Conquering {0}
scripts.translation: 征服{0}

scripts.text: Guild Dungeon Daily Quests
scripts.translation: 公会地下城每日委托

scripts.text: About quests
scripts.translation: 关于任务

scripts.text: I don't need it.
scripts.translation: 我不需要。

scripts.text: It's been less than an hour since the last time we've checked!
scripts.translation: 距离上次确认还不到一小时！

scripts.text: Come back when the waiting time is over.
scripts.translation: 等待时间结束后再回来。

scripts.text: If you have luck on your side, you'll have good results.
scripts.translation: 运气好的话，结果会不错。

scripts.text: I have confirmed that the waiting time for conquering missions has ended.
scripts.translation: 我确认征服任务的等待时间已经结束。

scripts.text: I'll delete unnecessary records for you.
scripts.translation: 我来替你删除不必要的记录。

scripts.text: According to ^4d4dffthe number of fortresses that your guild has conquered at this very moment,^000000 I'll give you a reward.
scripts.translation: 我会根据^4d4dff此刻你的公会所征服的城堡数量^000000发放奖励。

scripts.text: Do you want to check right now? You're aware that ^4d4dffthe number can change even as we speak,^000000 right?
scripts.translation: 现在要确认吗？你知道^4d4dff这个数量可能随时变化^000000，对吧？

scripts.text: I'll come back later.
scripts.translation: 我以后再来。

scripts.text: Let's check right now!
scripts.translation: 现在就确认！

scripts.text: Right. Life is all about timing.
scripts.translation: 没错，时机就是一切。

scripts.text: Come back when it's shining the most.
scripts.translation: 等到奖励最丰厚的时候再来。

scripts.text: Unfortunately, there is no fortress that your guild has conquered.
scripts.translation: 很遗憾，你的公会还没有征服任何城堡。

scripts.text: Try again!
scripts.translation: 再试一次！

scripts.text: Incredible.
scripts.translation: 真了不起。

scripts.text: Currently, the total number of fortresses that your guild has conquered
scripts.translation: 目前你的公会征服的城堡总数

scripts.text: Your guild has conquered {0}!
scripts.translation: 你的公会征服了{0}！
总数为{0}！

scripts.text: I'll give you a reward accordingly. I hope you make good use of it.
scripts.translation: 我会据此发放奖励，希望你善加利用。

scripts.text: You have an hour of waiting time until the next report. Keep that in mind and try again.
scripts.translation: 距离下次报告还有一小时等待时间。记住这一点，再来尝试。

scripts.text: I'm sorry but you can complete this mission only during the siege hours. I'm afraid I can't do anything here.
scripts.translation: 抱歉，这项任务只能在攻城战期间完成。我现在也无能为力。

scripts.text: I'm sorry but conquering missions are for guild masters only.
scripts.translation: 抱歉，只有公会会长才能接取征服任务。

scripts.text: Members should try guild dungeon daily quests instead.
scripts.translation: 公会成员可以改做公会地下城每日委托。

scripts.text: These are missions that you can complete in guild dungeons of {0} area.
scripts.translation: 这些任务可以在{0}地区的公会地下城完成。

scripts.text: You can cancel them if you want to. Feel free to challenge yourself.
scripts.translation: 你可以随时取消，也可以尽情挑战。

scripts.text: You don't need to rush since these missions take place in guild dungeons.
scripts.translation: 这些任务都在公会地下城进行，不必着急。

scripts.text: Feel free to give it a try whenever you want to.
scripts.translation: 想尝试时随时都可以来。

scripts.text: Hmm, unfortunately, this mission is limited to users with ^4d4dfflevel {0}^000000 or higher only.
scripts.translation: 很遗憾，这项任务仅限^4d4dff等级{0}以上^000000的玩家接取。

scripts.text: Your level is not high enough.
scripts.translation: 你的等级还不够。

scripts.text: Oh, you've done a good job.
scripts.translation: 哦，你做得很好。

scripts.text: It isn't much, but hopefully it will be helpful.
scripts.translation: 虽然不多，希望能帮上忙。

scripts.text: Hmm? It seems like you haven't completed the mission yet..
scripts.translation: 嗯？你好像还没完成任务...

scripts.text: Is there any problem?
scripts.translation: 遇到什么问题了吗？

scripts.text: No.
scripts.translation: 没有。

scripts.text: Give up the quest.
scripts.translation: 放弃任务。

scripts.text: I'm not sure how long you can use the guild dungeon, but good luck.
scripts.translation: 我不确定你还能在公会地下城待多久，祝你狩猎顺利。

scripts.text: Well, no one's forcing you.
scripts.translation: 嗯，没人逼你。

scripts.text: Do whatever you like to do.
scripts.translation: 想做什么就做什么吧。

scripts.text: I'll cancel the mission then.
scripts.translation: 那我取消任务了。

scripts.text: The rule is set here so that you're only allowed to complete one mission each day.
scripts.translation: 规则规定每天只能完成一项任务。

scripts.text: I would like you to come back when the waiting time is over.
scripts.translation: 等待时间结束后再回来吧。

scripts.text: I have confirmed that the waiting time for this mission is over.
scripts.translation: 我确认这项任务的等待时间已经结束。

scripts.text: I'll delete the records used for confirmation.
scripts.translation: 我会删除用于确认的记录。

scripts.text: Now, give it a try to complete the quest!
scripts.translation: 现在试着完成任务吧！

scripts.text: This is the {0} mission in {1}.
scripts.translation: 这是{0}任务，地点在{1}。

scripts.text: I'll reward you accordingly upon completing this mission.
scripts.translation: 完成任务后，我会相应地给你奖励。

scripts.text: I'll give you experience points in return.
scripts.translation: 我会给你经验值作为报酬。

scripts.text: Accept it.
scripts.translation: 接受

scripts.text: Reject it.
scripts.translation: 拒绝

scripts.text: Entrance to the guild dungeon is restricted. But it's not like you can't find a way to go there, either.
scripts.translation: 公会地下城入口受到管制。不过也不是完全没有办法进去。

scripts.text: I'll pray for your success in fighting those monsters.
scripts.translation: 祝你讨伐那些魔物顺利。

scripts.text: Well, do as you wish.
scripts.translation: 嗯，随你的便。

scripts.text: It's not difficult at all.
scripts.translation: 一点也不难。

scripts.text: I give a reward ^4d4dffdepending on how many fortresses you have conquered.^000000
scripts.translation: 我会^4d4dff根据你征服的城堡数量发放奖励。^000000

scripts.text: ^4d4dffThe type and quality of the reward depend on the number of conquered fortresses at the very moment I check.^000000
scripts.translation: ^4d4dff奖励的种类和品质取决于我确认时已征服的城堡数量。^000000

scripts.text: And of course, I check during the siege hours only.
scripts.translation: 当然，我只会在攻城战期间确认。

scripts.text: ^4d4dffReceiving a reward is followed by an hour of waiting time. So you'd better figure out the right timing as well.^000000
scripts.translation: ^4d4dff领取奖励后需要等待一小时才能再次领取，所以最好把握好时机。^000000

scripts.text: If you are a master of a guild that is currently participating in siege battles, you should give it a try.
scripts.translation: 如果你是正在参加攻城战的公会会长，不妨试试看。

scripts.text: Guild dungeon daily quests consist of combat quests that you can complete in guild dungeons.
scripts.translation: 公会地下城每日委托是可以在公会地下城完成的战斗任务。

scripts.text: It's simple.
scripts.translation: 很简单。

scripts.text: You're really something else~!
scripts.translation: 你真是了不起~！

scripts.text: It is to deal with the powerful creatures that appear in the Corridor of the Abyss.
scripts.translation: 任务是讨伐出现在深渊回廊的强大生物。

scripts.text: It is to eliminate the monsters that appear in the guild dungeon.
scripts.translation: 任务是消灭出现在公会地下城的魔物。

scripts.text: You should hunt 50 or more Caterpillars and Creamy Fear monsters..
scripts.translation: 狩猎至少50只幼虫和恐惧奶嘴怪。

scripts.text: Hunt down 30 or more of all 3 types of Abyss Kobolds.
scripts.translation: 狩猎三种深渊库伯怪各至少30只。

scripts.text: ^4d4dffYou should kill furious 'Pyuriel' and warrior 'Lora'.^000000
scripts.translation: ^4d4dff击败狂暴的“皮尤莉”和战士“劳拉”。^000000

scripts.text: ^4d4dffHunt 50 or more of Giant Hornets and Ancient Worms, respectively.^000000
scripts.translation: ^4d4dff分别狩猎至少50只大黄蜂和古老食人虫。^000000

scripts.text: ^4d4dffHunt 40 or more of Killer Mantises and 50 or more of Angra Mantises.^000000
scripts.translation: ^4d4dff狩猎至少40只杀人螳螂和50只安格拉螳螂。^000000

scripts.text: They are ^4d4dff'Elvira' and 'Gioia,' which is a strange mechanical creature of heroes' tears.^000000
scripts.translation: 它们是^4d4dff“艾尔薇拉”和“乔伊雅”，由英雄之泪变成的奇异机械生物。^000000

scripts.text: ^4d4dffHunt 50 or more Zombie Masters and Wraith Deads, respectively.^000000
scripts.translation: ^4d4dff分别狩猎至少50只僵尸首领和幽灵剑士。^000000

scripts.text: ^4d4dffHunt 50 GLD_DARK_SHADOW, 20 GLD_DARK_FRAME, and 20 GLD_DARK_PRIEST monsters.^000000
scripts.translation: ^4d4dff狩猎50只GLD_DARK_SHADOW、20只GLD_DARK_FRAME和20只GLD_DARK_PRIEST。^000000

scripts.text: They are ^4d4dff'Kades' and 'Rudo' who wander around the dead's hill.^000000
scripts.translation: 它们是徘徊在亡者之丘的^4d4dff“卡迪斯”和“鲁多”。^000000

scripts.text: ^4d4dffHunt 50 or more Gullinbursti and Leib Olmai, respectively.^000000
scripts.translation: ^4d4dff分别狩猎至少50只古代伍坦战士和毕帝特地龙。^000000

scripts.text: ^4d4dffHunt 45 or more Skeleton General, 20 or more Am Mut and 25 or more Gajomart, respectively.^000000
scripts.translation: ^4d4dff狩猎至少45只骷髅将军、20只安穆特和25只恶魔之眼。^000000

scripts.text: ^4d4dffThey are Old Empire's General 'Daehyon' and Guard 'Soheon'.^000000
scripts.translation: 它们是古代帝国的将军^4d4dff“大贤”和卫兵“昭贤”。^000000

scripts.text: ^4d4dffHunt 50 or more Hell Apocalypse and Zakudam, respectively.^000000
scripts.translation: ^4d4dff分别狩猎至少50只地狱邪恶箱和扎古丹。^000000

scripts.text: ^4d4dffHunt 35 or more Heavy Metaling and Cobalt Mineral, respectively.^000000
scripts.translation: ^4d4dff分别狩猎至少35只重金属蝗虫和钴矿石。^000000

scripts.text: ^4d4dffHunt more than 50 Banshee Masters and 30 Beholder Masters.^000000
scripts.translation: ^4d4dff狩猎至少50只女妖首领和30只监视者首领。^000000

scripts.text: ^4d4dffHunt 50 Aunoes, and 20 Fanats.^000000
scripts.translation: ^4d4dff狩猎50只奥诺斯和20只凡纳斯。^000000

scripts.text: ^4d4dffHunt 30 or more Knight, Blacksmith, Assassin, respectively.^000000
scripts.translation: ^4d4dff分别狩猎至少30只骑士、铁匠和刺客。^000000

scripts.text: ^4d4dffHunt 30 or more Wizard, Priest, Hunter respectively.^000000
scripts.translation: ^4d4dff分别狩猎至少30只巫师、牧师和猎人。^000000

scripts.text: ^4d4dffHunt 30 or more, Crusader, Rogue, Alchemist, respectively.^000000
scripts.translation: ^4d4dff分别狩猎至少30只十字军、流氓和炼金术士。^000000

scripts.text: ^4d4dffHunt 30 or more Sage, Monk, Bard, respectively.^000000
scripts.translation: ^4d4dff分别狩猎至少30只贤者、武僧和吟游诗人。^000000
